title: Ten endpoints, ranked by tail latency
description: Ranked p99 latency with single-line routes, aligned readings and a dashed SLO; red bars and ! marks identify breaches in the five-minute window.

props.name: data
props.description: Application observations with route and p99Ms, ranked slowest first. Repeated route labels remain separate rows; invalid or negative readings are omitted and counted as unavailable. Request-rate metadata is not required.

props.name: objectiveMs
props.description: Nonnegative p99 objective; invalid objectives leave bars unclassified.

props.name: height
props.description: Optional total height in pixels. By default the chart grows with the route count; constrained plots scroll locally to preserve readable rows.

props.name: width
props.description: Fixed width in pixels; otherwise fills the containing element.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes on the outer console frame.

props.name: animate
props.description: Enable token-timed motion subject to the system reduced-motion preference.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible description of what this instance measures.

props.name: label
props.description: Label beside the current breach count.

props.name: source
props.description: Source text in the existing status footer.

props.name: window
props.description: Measurement window in the existing status footer.

props.name: updated
props.description: Caller-supplied freshness text in the existing status footer.
